title: The Great Dog Coeur's Triumph 2
notes: Detective-cast (Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, Haibara) omitted by convention. case_type: murder (fatal fall caused during a confrontation, then concealed). The old cases/ file correctly named Fujiki as the culprit and the fall-down-the-stairs mechanism, but was otherwise very sparse: it had only one suspect-role node each for Ohga/Eguchi/Fujiki with no other named cast, a single generic 'Underground passageway' location, and 'knows' edges standing in for real relationships. This rebuild adds the full named cast present in the transcript (Yagisawa who drew the dog-walking map; victim's daughter Sawako; Ohga's wife Misako and son Tomoya; Fujiki's mother Shizuko), the real six scene locations, the Ohga-Eguchi secret affair that explains Ohga's red-herring nervous reaction to the map, the map-theft clue that first points Conan at all three households, and the two-cigarette-butt mix-up (real butt with the victim's blood vs. Eguchi's discarded butt with lipstick mistaken for blood) as the forensic clue that isolates Fujiki. No discrepancy found in the old file's culprit identification itself.
